description: Spends the user's Freebeat credits. quote_generation returns the current price or reports that the total is unknown. The server submits only with max_credits at or above the current quote, or with accept_unknown_cost:true when no total can be quoted. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Freebeat videos are made by a director agent that works in stages, as on freebeat.ai, where a person chats with it and sees what it made. In auto mode it makes the creative decisions and delivers the film; otherwise it pauses for the person's input where taste matters. get_video_session shows its words, stage statuses and work; send_video_agent_message passes on the person's feedback, approval or direction, or hands the rest to auto. Work that follows a message is charged per stage like the rest of the session. A song whose audio is still being analyzed returns preparing with its numeric music_id and retry_after_seconds instead of a task_id; no paid video starts before the audio is ready. Use this for dance video generation: the user wants dancers performing to a song. Freebeat's dance video agent plans and generates a dance video timed to the song; people in optional photos become the dancers. Supports vertical 9:16 and 3:4 formats. A 2026-10-27 production diagnosis found 855 credits for the video step alone of a 15-second 720p dance, with planning and images extra: budget on the order of 1,000 credits, not a fixed quote or cap. Requires music_id from upload_audio or a completed generate_music result; optional photos via upload_image. Starts a generation job that uses the user's existing Freebeat credits and usually takes 15–60 minutes; by default it uses the first 15 seconds of the song, or up to the song's end if shorter. Returns task_id and session_url; poll get_task_status every few minutes, call get_task_result after completed; on action_required read get_video_session and use send_video_agent_message to continue. Do not use for story-based music videos, lyric videos, short singing-photo clips, lip-sync of an existing clip, standalone video clips without a song, or generating audio.

accept_unknown_cost.description: true means the user accepted that the total is unknown; used without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; no total budget is enforced.

auto_mode.description: true: the director agent makes the creative decisions and delivers the film. false: it pauses for the person's input, which get_video_session shows and send_video_agent_message answers.

end_ms.description: End of the song window in milliseconds. Defaults to start_ms + 15000, capped at the song end. The selected window must fit the song and the account limits.

image_urls.description: Optional photo URLs from upload_image of the dancers to feature.

max_credits.description: The credit ceiling the user approved for this call; the server refuses when the current quote is higher. It cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run.

music_id.description: An analyzed music_id from upload_audio, or result.music_id from a completed generate_music task.

prompt.description: The user's creative direction in their own words. Leave empty to let the agent decide.

remove_watermark.description: Remove the Freebeat watermark if the account allows it.

start_ms.description: Start of the song window in milliseconds. Defaults to 0.

name: generate_dance_video

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

music_id.description: Prepared audio asset to reuse on a preparing response.

session_url.description: The freebeat.ai page where the user can watch, review, or continue this session.

status.description: The initial task status, typically pending.

task_id.description: The scoped task ID for get_task_status and get_task_result.
